spiritual_reading:
Three distinct excellences were opened in the first human state, and by these it stood above the combined powers acting in the higher and lower degrees.

First: the Divine likeness was impressed upon that first state. Those who bring the outward form into order fixed it according to the radiant pattern that had been shown to their higher perception. Therefore that first state appeared in a beauty beyond any unified power in the inner or outer domain.

Second: that first state was organized in its whole constitution by the illumination of the primary truth that proceeds from the inner heaven, together with a sufficient complement of operative powers. Therefore its constitution differed from all other formed states, because each order of life has its own distinct arrangement. In that first state the inmost life was fitted to a right ordering of the fundamental qualities of receptivity, and so it possessed an understanding above other formed lives and their lower affections.

Third: within it were gathered the teachings, the directing perceptions, and the conjoining fixations of all powers acting from within and from without. Those who arranged that state collected these things and made them permanent within it. That first human state together with its paired reception of life became a containing form for the complete ordering of cyclical changes and all measured variations of state, from larger to smaller and back again. Thus the full order of the whole domain was impressed upon the first human state. Therefore the inner and outer degrees were stirred because of it, and contention and disturbance arose on its account between goods and evils: goods drew it toward living conjunction because the Divine likeness and form had been set within it, while evils drew it toward spiritual death so that they might rule through it, establish a dominion, and by means of it abase the entire order.

Further, it is to be understood that the ruling evils determined and arranged that first human state so that they might become masters through it and establish dominion, and they did this for a complete series of purposes.

The first purpose: that it might become the enlightener for their own formed states in place of the higher illumination of the Divine mediation that had been shown to their perception; for they all longed for that likeness, and their will was drawn toward it.

The second: that they might draw light through that first state and hold it down, preventing its return to higher degrees.

The third: that by means of the Divine mediation’s likeness impressed upon that first state, everything of the Divine in the inner and outer degrees might be brought into contempt, because the splendour of that likeness appeared in a superior beauty, and that first state outshone all other formed lives.

The fourth: that it might be a conjoining fixation and a fresh determination, so that all later human states brought forth might come into existence in the same general form.

The fifth: that through it all the abilities of the powers acting within and without—those hidden and those openly operative—might be displayed, and that they might measure and define the whole extent of their dominion by it, so that each thing would stand revealed within that human form.

The sixth: that through the Divine likeness placed upon it there would come to be a great safeguarding for them, because the heavenly order would restrain even the ruling evils, and no evil would be inflicted upon them on account of that first state.

The seventh: that it might become chief and ruling over all formed lives in the outer domain, and that they might establish dominion through it.

fills.notes: The constitution is said to be shaped “through the light of the first-born of heaven” and then immediately qualified by “the five sons.” The oldest-layer cosmological logic is a twofold derivation (heavenly and earthly) followed by the operative pentad. “Earth, through” supplies the missing second pole (heaven and earth as discrete degrees) and links it syntactically to “the five sons” as the mediating operative powers.

In the sixth purpose the safeguarding arises “through the image of the exalted one,” because the heavenly order acts as a check upon the lower ruling powers. The correspondential requirement is a verb of limitation: the heavenly (higher order) curbs the rulers (lower evils). “Restrain” matches the spiritual translation’s sense (“would restrain even rulers”) and keeps the oldest substrate register (impersonal cosmic constraint, not moral exhortation).

assessment: All lacunae are recoverable. Three are trivial letter-restorations. The two substantive gaps are tightly constrained by the chapter’s discrete-degree structure: (1) the second pole to “heaven” plus a connective into the pentadic operative powers; (2) a verb of heavenly constraint upon rulers in the safeguarding purpose. Exact phrasing in ¶4 #1 remains the least certain, but the required cosmological relations (heaven–earth, then the five sons as operative mediation) fix the reconstruction within a narrow range.
